observed.caption: Aerial view of a lush green forested mountain ridge with a grassy trail under a partly cloudy sky.
observed.description: A long forested mountain ridge covered in dense green trees and vegetation extends into the distance, with a narrow grassy clearing and dirt trail running along its crest. Two small figures are visible walking on the grassy area. The ridge is surrounded by more forested slopes and a hazy distant plain is visible to the left under a pale blue sky with scattered white clouds. Sunlight illuminates the scene from above, casting soft shadows from the trees onto the grass.
